ValidationRule.description: Restricts invalid stage transitions in the sales pipeline for standard accounts with no accepted quotes, ensuring users strictly follow the defined quote process.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(NOT(ISCHANGED(SkipValidations__c)), ISCHANGED(StageName), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Account.TypeOfChain__c, "Chain")), AcceptedQuotes__c = 0, OR(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Discovery"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Qualification"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Quote Sent"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Quotation Phase")), OR(ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Renegotiation"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Quote Signed"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Quote Sent"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won")))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Cannot change from the current stage to the selected stage! Please follow the quote process!
